description: The source rule R-001 says every later copy of S1-S5 comes from the Pragmatic output style, never from the inventory text; the constraint now says the opposite, so copies can drift from the style.

The source rule R-012 asks for a check that the Fix Cycles line says a fix runs only for blocking findings; the criterion now only finds the prefix and the old wording's absence, so a line without the blocking wording passes.
The added alternative fix cycles occurs in S3, which the same task orders into the file (at most 2 fix cycles (3 reviews)), so the grep prints that line and the criterion can never pass.

quote: -i -F 'FAIL: Issues found|strictly fewer issues|logged for human review|zero-tolerance policy for errors'
description: With the fixed-string flag the vertical bars are literal characters, so the pattern matches no line of any file and the prints-nothing check can never fail.

quote: Apply every row of group `portify` (22 rows):

quote: no other file in the repository is touched by any task

The dictated line says max 3 cycles per phase, while the same task's acceptance line requires max 2 cycles per phase and a grep for the 3-cycle wording to print nothing, and the goal caps loops at 2 fix cycles.
